tagline.zh: 让 Agent 打开网页、点按钮、填表单、截图
tagline.en: Let the agent open pages, click, fill forms and take screenshots

description.zh: Microsoft 官方 Playwright MCP（0.0.84）。基于无障碍树操作真实浏览器，稳定、省 token，支持导航、点击、填表、上传、截图、网络与控制台。MCP Station 自动使用本机 Chrome（--browser chrome），避免 Playwright 自带 Chromium 版本缺失导致的启动失败。默认会把浏览器 profile 持久化到本机缓存目录，登录态可跨会话保留。
description.en: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP (0.0.84). Drives a real browser through the accessibility tree: navigate, click, fill forms, upload, screenshot, network and console. MCP Station uses the local Chrome (--browser chrome) so missing bundled Chromium revisions cannot break startup. The browser profile is persisted under the local cache by default, so sign-ins survive across sessions.

reasons.zh: 可读取并操作你已登录的网页内容
reasons.en: Can read and operate pages you are logged in to

reasons.zh: 可执行页面脚本、上传与下载文件
reasons.en: Can evaluate page scripts and upload/download files

reasons.zh: 默认持久化浏览器 profile（含登录态）
reasons.en: Persists the browser profile (including sign-ins) by default

note.zh: 默认有头模式，能看到浏览器窗口；--headless 无头、--isolated 使用内存 profile。实测工具名与参数有效，example.com 导航因本机验证沙箱无法启动 Chrome 沙箱而未完成（见 docs/presets.md）。
note.en: Headed by default so you can watch; use --headless for headless mode and --isolated for an in-memory profile. Tool names and flags verified; the example.com navigate smoke could not complete in the verification sandbox because Chrome's own sandbox cannot start (see docs/presets.md).

tagline.zh: 前端调试、性能 Trace、网络与控制台
tagline.en: Frontend debugging, performance traces, network and console

description.zh: Google 官方 Chrome DevTools MCP（1.12.0），提供 32 个工具。适合调试前端、抓网络请求、看控制台错误、跑性能 Trace。默认使用本机 Chrome，并已用 --no-usage-statistics、--no-performance-crux 关闭 Google 的使用统计与 CrUX 数据上报。
description.en: Google's official Chrome DevTools MCP (1.12.0) with 32 tools for frontend debugging, network inspection, console errors and performance traces. Uses the local Chrome; --no-usage-statistics and --no-performance-crux opt out of Google usage statistics and CrUX uploads.

reasons.zh: 可读取页面内容、网络请求与控制台输出
reasons.en: Can read page content, network requests and console output

reasons.zh: 可修改页面状态并采集运行时数据
reasons.en: Can modify page state and collect runtime data

note.zh: 1.12 起页面级工具（navigate_page、take_snapshot 等）需要 pageId，先用 list_pages/new_page 获取；默认 profile 保存在 ~/.cache/chrome-devtools-mcp。实测 tools/list 返回 32 个工具，navigate_page 缺 pageId 会被拒绝（符合预期）。
note.en: Since 1.12, page-scoped tools (navigate_page, take_snapshot, ...) require a pageId; get one with list_pages/new_page. The default profile lives in ~/.cache/chrome-devtools-mcp. Verified: tools/list returns 32 tools; navigate_page without pageId is rejected as expected.

tagline.zh: 让 Agent 读写指定目录里的文件
tagline.en: Let the agent read and write files in a chosen directory

description.zh: MCP 官方 Filesystem server（2.2.0），提供 16 个工具：读、写、编辑、复制、移动、搜索、列目录与文件信息。把指定目录暴露给 Agent；默认根目录为当前 DSH 工作区，建议只授权项目目录，不要直接授权整个用户目录。
description.en: The official MCP Filesystem server (2.2.0) with 16 tools: read, write, edit, copy, move, search, list and inspect files. Exposes one or more directories to the agent. Defaults to the current DSH workspace; grant a project directory, never your whole home directory.

description.zh: 只给需要的项目目录；不要用 ~ 或 /
description.en: Only the project directory needed; avoid ~ or /

reasons.zh: 可读写授权目录中的文件
reasons.en: Can read and write files under the granted directory

reasons.zh: 可删除、移动与复制文件
reasons.en: Can delete, move and copy files

reasons.zh: 授权范围过大时风险显著上升
reasons.en: Risk grows sharply if the granted root is too broad

note.zh: 2.2.0 声明 Node.js ≥ 24（Node 22 会打印 EBADENGINE 告警，但 2026-11-06 在 Node 22.22.3 实测可用）。只读场景可加 --read-only 参数（目录后面）。
note.en: 2.2.0 declares Node.js >= 24 (Node 22 logs an EBADENGINE warning but worked on Node 22.22.3 in the 2026-11-06 run). For read-only use, add --read-only to the arguments.

tagline.zh: 跨会话保存实体、关系与观察
tagline.en: Persist entities, relations and observations across sessions

description.zh: MCP 官方 Memory server（2.1.0），提供 9 个工具：用本地知识图谱记住实体、关系与观察，适合跨会话的项目上下文。默认写入 DSH Home 下的 mcp-station-memory.json。
description.en: The official MCP Memory server (2.1.0) with 9 tools: a local knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations for cross-session context. Defaults to mcp-station-memory.json under DSH Home.

description.zh: JSONL 文件（每行一个 JSON 对象），不存在会自动创建；父目录必须已存在
description.en: JSONL file (one JSON object per line), created automatically; its parent directory must already exist

reasons.zh: 只读写本地一个记忆文件
reasons.en: Reads and writes one local memory file

note.zh: 文件实际格式是 JSONL（扩展名可随意）；2.1.0 不会创建父目录，父目录不存在时写入报 ENOENT。2.1.0 声明 Node.js ≥ 24，Node 22 会告警但实测可用。
note.en: The on-disk format is JSONL regardless of extension; 2.1.0 does not create parent directories and fails with ENOENT if missing. 2.1.0 declares Node.js >= 24 (Node 22 warns but worked in the 2026-11-06 run).

tagline.zh: 读仓库、Issue、PR；按 token 权限操作
tagline.en: Read repos, issues and PRs; act within token scope

description.zh: MCP 官方 GitHub server（npm 包已归档，版本 2025.4.8，提供 26 个工具）。需要环境变量 GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN（不会写进 profile 配置文件）；未配置时只能匿名调用公开 API。0.1.x 的稳定性 id 保留，建议用只读或最小权限的 fine-grained token；官方替代见 note。
description.en: The official MCP GitHub server (npm package archived, version 2025.4.8, 26 tools). Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the environment (never written to the profile patch); without it only anonymous public API calls work. The id is kept stable for 0.1.x compatibility; use a read-only or least-privilege fine-grained token. See note for the maintained alternative.

reasons.zh: token 权限范围内的仓库可读，甚至可写
reasons.en: Repos within the token scope may be readable or writable

reasons.zh: 可能接触私有代码与 Issue 内容
reasons.en: May access private code and issue content

reasons.zh: npm 包已归档、不再维护，无安全保证
reasons.en: Archived npm package, unmaintained with no security guarantees

note.zh: npm 包已归档（2025.4.8），但为保持 0.1.x preset id 稳定而保留。官方推荐远程 MCP https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/（需要 Authorization 头，当前 CatalogPreset schema 不支持 headers）或 Docker 版 ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server；也可用“自定义服务器/导入”自行配置。注意：server 读取的是 GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN；catalog 默认注入 env:GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN，未配置时仅匿名访问公开数据。
note.en: The npm package is archived (2025.4.8) but retained to keep the 0.1.x preset id stable. GitHub recommends the remote MCP at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ (needs an Authorization header, which the current CatalogPreset schema cannot express) or the Docker image ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server; configure either through Custom Server / Import. Note: the server reads GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; the catalog maps it from the same-named host env var, and without it only anonymous public data is reachable.

tagline.zh: 按库名取最新版官方文档与示例
tagline.en: Fetch up-to-date library docs and examples

description.zh: Context7（4.5.1）把常用开源库的最新文档注入上下文，减少模型凭记忆编 API。工具为 resolve-library-id 与 query-docs；无需 API key（有速率限制），可选 CONTEXT7_API_KEY 或 --api-key 提升额度。
description.en: Context7 (4.5.1) injects up-to-date documentation for popular open-source libraries. Tools: resolve-library-id and query-docs. No API key required (rate limited); an optional CONTEXT7_API_KEY or --api-key raises limits.

reasons.zh: 会把你查询的库名发到 Context7 服务
reasons.en: Sends the library names you query to the Context7 service

note.zh: 实测 resolve-library-id 需要同时传 libraryName 与 query，未带 key 也能返回结果；query-docs 用上一步拿到的 /org/project 形式 ID。
note.en: Verified resolve-library-id requires both libraryName and query; it returns results without a key. query-docs takes the /org/project ID returned by the first call.

tagline.zh: 为 Agent 优化的联网搜索 API
tagline.en: Web search API optimized for agents

description.zh: Tavily 远程 MCP（Streamable HTTP，server 4.1.5）：联网搜索、提取网页、爬站与站点地图，工具为 tavily_search、tavily_extract、tavily_crawl、tavily_map、tavily_research。需要 Tavily API key；key 会出现在远程 URL 中，请勿在共享机器上使用。
description.en: Tavily remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, server 4.1.5): web search, page extraction, crawling and site maps with tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_crawl, tavily_map and tavily_research. Requires a Tavily API key; the key appears in the remote URL, so avoid shared machines.

description.zh: 从 tavily.com 获取；会随 URL 写入本机 profile 配置
description.en: Get one at tavily.com; stored in the local profile patch inside the URL

reasons.zh: 查询内容会发送到 Tavily 云端
reasons.en: Queries are sent to Tavily's cloud

reasons.zh: API key 会写入本机配置文件
reasons.en: The API key is written into the local profile patch

note.zh: 端点与官方文档一致：无 key 时 initialize 返回 401，带 key 时 initialize 返回 200（实测用占位 key 验证了协议与工具列表；实际搜索调用需要真实 key）。
note.en: Endpoint matches the official docs: initialize returns 401 without a key and 200 with one (protocol and tool list verified with a placeholder key; real searches need a real key).

tagline.zh: 把复杂问题拆成可回溯的思考步骤
tagline.en: Break complex problems into revisable thinking steps

description.zh: MCP 官方 Sequential Thinking server（2.1.1），提供 sequentialthinking 工具，让 Agent 逐步拆解问题、回溯与分支。纯本地运行，不联网、不改文件，适合规划、排查与方案对比。
description.en: The official MCP Sequential Thinking server (2.1.1). One sequentialthinking tool lets the agent plan step by step, revise and branch. Runs locally with no network or file writes; useful for planning, debugging and comparing options.

reasons.zh: 只在内存中记录思考步骤，不访问网络或文件
reasons.en: Keeps thinking steps in memory; no network or file access

note.zh: 2.1.1 声明 Node.js ≥ 24；Node 22 会告警但实测可用。若上次安装的是旧版 server-sequential-thinking，参数名可能不同，升级即可。
note.en: 2.1.1 declares Node.js >= 24; Node 22 warns but works in practice. Older server-sequential-thinking installs may use different argument names; upgrade to match.

tagline.zh: 用参考服务器验证 MCP 客户端能力
tagline.en: Prove MCP client behavior with a reference server

description.zh: MCP 官方 Everything 参考服务器（2.2.1），覆盖工具、资源、提示词、日志、进度与结构化输出，共 16 个示例工具，用于验证 MCP Station 的连通性、工具列表与结果渲染，不是日常生产工具。
description.en: The official MCP Everything reference server (2.2.1): tools, resources, prompts, logging, progress and structured output across 16 demo tools. Use it to validate MCP Station connectivity, tool listing and result rendering; it is not a production server.

reasons.zh: get-env 会返回服务器进程的环境变量，可能包含密钥
reasons.en: get-env returns the server process environment, which may contain secrets

reasons.zh: 仅用于测试，工具行为不代表真实业务
reasons.en: Testing-only; tool behavior is not a real workload

note.zh: 参考/测试服务器：2.2.1 声明 Node.js ≥ 24，Node 22 会告警但实测可用；不要把 get-env 的结果贴到公开场合。
note.en: Reference/testing server: 2.2.1 declares Node.js >= 24 (Node 22 warns but works). Do not paste get-env output into public places.

tagline.zh: 查页面、数据库与评论，按 token 权限读写
tagline.en: Search pages and databases, read comments within token scope

description.zh: Notion 官方 MCP server（2.6.1，24 个工具）。用 integration token 访问页面、数据源与评论，并把页面 markdown 转成结构化内容；token 走 NOTION_TOKEN 环境变量，不写进 profile。
description.en: Official Notion MCP server (2.6.1, 24 tools). Access pages, data sources and comments with an integration token and read page markdown; the token is read from NOTION_TOKEN and never written to the profile.

reasons.zh: token 权限内的页面与数据库可读，部分工具可写
reasons.en: Pages and databases within the token scope are readable; some tools can write

reasons.zh: 可能接触团队私有文档与评论
reasons.en: May access private team documents and comments

note.zh: 需要 Notion integration token（ntn_...），并在 Notion 里把目标页面/数据库分享给该 integration；不要用个人账号密码。
note.en: Needs a Notion integration token (ntn_...) and the target pages/databases must be shared with that integration. Never use account passwords.

tagline.zh: 读取频道消息、搜索与发消息（默认关闭发送）
tagline.en: Read channels, search messages, and optionally post

description.zh: Slack MCP server（slack-mcp-server 1.3.0，基于 Go 二进制，下载体积小）。支持频道/消息读取、搜索与发消息；发消息与互动默认关闭，需显式设置环境变量开启。
description.en: Slack MCP server (slack-mcp-server 1.3.0, a small Go binary). Reads channels and messages, searches and optionally posts; posting and reactions are disabled by default and need explicit env flags.

reasons.zh: 可读取工作区频道与消息内容
reasons.en: Can read workspace channels and message content

reasons.zh: token/cookie 泄露等同于工作区访问权限
reasons.en: A leaked token or cookie grants workspace access

reasons.zh: 开启写工具后可发消息、加表情
reasons.en: After enabling write tools it can post messages and add reactions

note.zh: 需要 SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN（用户 token），或 SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN + SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN 组合。server 启动即校验 token，本次未能取得 tools/list；发消息需另设 SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL。
note.en: Requires SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN, or SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN + SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN. The server verifies the token at startup, so tools/list could not be captured in this run; posting also needs SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL.

tagline.zh: 搜索与维护 issue、项目、周期与团队
tagline.en: Search and manage issues, projects and cycles

description.zh: Linear 社区维护的 MCP server（@tacticlaunch/mcp-linear 1.4.5，198 个工具）。覆盖 issue、项目、路线图、发布、团队与标签的读写，使用 LINEAR_API_TOKEN 或 OAuth token。
description.en: Community Linear MCP server (@tacticlaunch/mcp-linear 1.4.5, 198 tools). Covers issues, projects, roadmaps, releases, teams and labels via LINEAR_API_TOKEN or an OAuth token.

reasons.zh: token 权限内的 issue 与项目可读，部分工具可写
reasons.en: Issues and projects within the token scope are readable; some tools can write

reasons.zh: 可能接触私有项目与成员信息
reasons.en: May access private projects and member information

note.zh: 需要 Linear API token（LINEAR_API_TOKEN），也支持 --token/--oauth-token 参数。
note.en: Needs a Linear API token (LINEAR_API_TOKEN); --token/--oauth-token are also supported.

tagline.zh: 仓库、MR、Issue 与流水线
tagline.en: Repos, merge requests, issues and pipelines

description.zh: GitLab MCP server（@zereight/mcp-gitlab 2.3.22，默认 40 个工具，可 discover_tools 展开）。覆盖项目、MR、Issue、分支、提交、流水线与 Wiki，适合 gitlab.com 与自建实例。
description.en: GitLab MCP server (@zereight/mcp-gitlab 2.3.22, 40 tools by default with discover_tools expansion). Covers projects, MRs, issues, branches, commits, pipelines and wiki for gitlab.com and self-hosted instances.

reasons.zh: token 权限内的仓库可读，甚至可写
reasons.en: Repos within the token scope may be readable or writable

reasons.zh: 可创建 MR/Issue 与评论
reasons.en: Can create MRs, issues and comments

note.zh: 需要 GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN；自建 GitLab 把 GITLAB_API_URL 改成 https://<host>/api/v4。默认工具集约 40 个，避免设置 GITLAB_TOOLSETS=all（上下文会膨胀）。
note.en: Needs GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; for self-hosted GitLab set GITLAB_API_URL to https://<host>/api/v4. Keep the default ~40 tools; avoid GITLAB_TOOLSETS=all (huge context).

tagline.zh: 用只读或受控账号查询 Postgres
tagline.en: Query Postgres with a read-only or scoped account

description.zh: DBHub（@bytebase/dbhub 1.5.1，官方示例中的数据库 MCP）。支持 PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite 等，默认只加载 execute_sql 与 search_objects 两个工具；建议用只读账号。
description.en: DBHub (@bytebase/dbhub 1.5.1, the database MCP used in official examples). Supports PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite and loads just execute_sql + search_objects by default; use a read-only account.

description.zh: 形如 postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db；会写入本机 profile，建议用只读账号
description.en: e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db; stored in the local profile, so prefer a read-only account

reasons.zh: 可执行任意 SQL（含写操作）
reasons.en: Can execute arbitrary SQL, including writes

reasons.zh: 连接串含密码并写入 profile
reasons.en: The DSN contains a password and is stored in the profile

note.zh: DSN 会写入 profile，建议只读账号与最小权限；DBHub 支持 --readonly/--max-rows 等参数（按需在 args 里追加）。
note.en: The DSN is stored in the profile; prefer a read-only, least-privilege account. DBHub supports --readonly/--max-rows and more (append to args if needed).

tagline.zh: 查询本地 SQLite 数据库文件
tagline.en: Query local SQLite database files

description.zh: DBHub 的 SQLite 模式（@bytebase/dbhub 1.5.1）。直接连接本地 .sqlite 文件，默认两个工具 execute_sql 与 search_objects；文件不存在时会自动创建。
description.en: DBHub in SQLite mode (@bytebase/dbhub 1.5.1). Connects to a local .sqlite file with execute_sql and search_objects; the file is created when missing.

description.zh: 本地数据库文件路径；父目录必须存在
description.en: Local database file; its parent directory must exist

reasons.zh: 可读写本地数据库文件
reasons.en: Can read and write the local database file

reasons.zh: SQL 可修改或删除数据
reasons.en: SQL can modify or delete data

note.zh: 无需 key；默认建库文件在 {{workspace}}/mcp-station.sqlite，可在安装时改成别的路径。
note.en: No key needed; the default database file is {{workspace}}/mcp-station.sqlite and can be changed at install time.

tagline.zh: 用 kubectl 读写集群资源、日志与 Helm
tagline.en: kubectl resources, logs and Helm charts

description.zh: Kubernetes MCP server（mcp-server-kubernetes 4.2.1，23 个工具）。基于 kubectl 操作 Pod、Deployment、日志、exec、端口转发与 Helm；默认读取 ~/.kube/config。
description.en: Kubernetes MCP server (mcp-server-kubernetes 4.2.1, 23 tools). Uses kubectl for pods, deployments, logs, exec, port-forward and Helm; reads ~/.kube/config by default.

reasons.zh: 可创建/修改/删除集群资源
reasons.en: Can create, change and delete cluster resources

reasons.zh: 可读取 Secret 与容器日志
reasons.en: Can read secrets and container logs

reasons.zh: 误操作可能影响生产集群
reasons.en: Mistakes can affect production clusters

note.zh: 需要本机安装 kubectl 并配置 kubeconfig；建议给只读或命名空间受限的 context。smoke 用 ping（不依赖集群）。
note.en: Requires kubectl and a kubeconfig; prefer a read-only or namespace-scoped context. The smoke calls ping, which does not need a cluster.

tagline.zh: 查 issue、事件、trace 与告警
tagline.en: Issues, events, traces and alerts

description.zh: Sentry 官方 MCP server（@sentry/mcp-server 0.49.0，73 个工具）。搜索与定位 issue、事件堆栈、trace、replay、日志，并管理告警与项目设置；支持自建 Sentry。
description.en: Official Sentry MCP server (@sentry/mcp-server 0.49.0, 73 tools). Search issues, event stack traces, traces, replays and logs, and manage alerts and project settings; self-hosted Sentry is supported.

reasons.zh: 可读取错误事件与用户上下文
reasons.en: Can read error events and user context

reasons.zh: 部分工具可修改 issue 与告警
reasons.en: Some tools can modify issues and alerts

note.zh: 需要 SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN；自建 Sentry 另设 SENTRY_HOST 或 SENTRY_URL。旧的 SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN 仍兼容但会提示弃用。
note.en: Needs SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN; for self-hosted Sentry also set SENTRY_HOST or SENTRY_URL. The old SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN still works but is deprecated.

tagline.zh: 在本地仓库做 status/diff/log/commit
tagline.en: Local status, diff, log and commit

description.zh: Git MCP server（@cyanheads/git-mcp-server 2.15.3，28 个工具）。覆盖 status、diff、log、blame、clone、commit、branch、merge、rebase、stash、tag 等本地 Git 操作。
description.en: Git MCP server (@cyanheads/git-mcp-server 2.15.3, 28 tools). Covers status, diff, log, blame, clone, commit, branch, merge, rebase, stash and tag operations.

reasons.zh: 可提交、推送、重置、删除分支
reasons.en: Can commit, push, reset and delete branches

reasons.zh: 可能误改工作区文件与历史
reasons.en: Can modify working tree files and history

note.zh: 默认把操作限制在 GIT_BASE_DIR={{workspace}}；工具需要传入仓库/文件路径。因没有安全的无参调用，未配置 smoke。
note.en: Operations are limited to GIT_BASE_DIR={{workspace}}; tools take repository/file paths. No safe argument-free call exists, so no smoke is configured.

tagline.zh: 查询与维护 MongoDB / Atlas 数据
tagline.en: Query and manage MongoDB / Atlas data

description.zh: MongoDB 官方 MCP server（mongodb-mcp-server 3.2.2，27 个工具）。支持 aggregate、find、insert、索引与 schema 检查，也可连接 Atlas；连接串走环境变量。
description.en: Official MongoDB MCP server (mongodb-mcp-server 3.2.2, 27 tools). Aggregate, find, insert, index and schema inspection, locally or on Atlas; the connection string comes from an environment variable.

reasons.zh: 可读写、删除数据库/集合
reasons.en: Can read, write and drop databases/collections

reasons.zh: 连接串含数据库凭据
reasons.en: The connection string carries database credentials

note.zh: 需要 MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING（mongodb:// 或 mongodb+srv://）；建议用只读账号。首次运行会写 ~/.mongodb，可用 HOME 重定向。
note.en: Needs MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING (mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://); prefer a read-only user. The first run writes ~/.mongodb, which can be redirected with HOME.

tagline.zh: 项目、表、SQL、分支与 Edge Functions
tagline.en: Projects, tables, SQL, branches and Edge Functions

description.zh: Supabase 官方 MCP server（@supabase/mcp-server-supabase 0.16.1，36 个工具）。管理组织/项目、查表结构、执行 SQL、管理迁移、分支与 Edge Functions。
description.en: Official Supabase MCP server (@supabase/mcp-server-supabase 0.16.1, 36 tools). Manage orgs/projects, inspect tables, run SQL, manage migrations, branches and Edge Functions.

reasons.zh: 可执行 SQL 与迁移，影响数据库
reasons.en: Can run SQL and migrations that change the database

reasons.zh: 可管理项目与密钥类信息
reasons.en: Can manage projects and key material

note.zh: 需要 SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN；可在 args 追加 --project-ref 限定单个项目，避免全组织权限。
note.en: Needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; append --project-ref to scope the server to one project instead of the whole org.

tagline.zh: 读写本地 xlsx 表格与单元格
tagline.en: Read and write local xlsx sheets and cells

description.zh: Excel MCP server（@negokaz/excel-mcp-server 0.12.0，6 个工具）。读取/写入/复制 sheet、创建表格、格式化单元格范围；文件路径限制在 EXCEL_FILES_PATH 下。
description.en: Excel MCP server (@negokaz/excel-mcp-server 0.12.0, 6 tools). Read/write/copy sheets, create tables and format ranges; file paths are restricted to EXCEL_FILES_PATH.

reasons.zh: 可读写工作区内的 xlsx 文件
reasons.en: Can read and write xlsx files in the workspace

reasons.zh: 写操作可能覆盖原有单元格内容
reasons.en: Writes can overwrite existing cell content

note.zh: 文件访问限制在 EXCEL_FILES_PATH={{workspace}}；工具必须传具体 xlsx 路径，没有安全的无参调用，故未配置 smoke。
note.en: File access is limited to EXCEL_FILES_PATH={{workspace}}; tools need a concrete xlsx path, so no argument-free smoke exists.

tagline.zh: 网页、图片、视频、新闻与本地搜索
tagline.en: Web, image, video, news and local search

description.zh: Brave 官方搜索 MCP server（@brave/brave-search-mcp-server 2.1.4，8 个工具）。提供 web/local/video/image/news 搜索、摘要与 LLM context，使用 BRAVE_API_KEY。
description.en: Official Brave Search MCP server (@brave/brave-search-mcp-server 2.1.4, 8 tools): web/local/video/image/news search, summarizer and LLM context via BRAVE_API_KEY.

reasons.zh: 查询与结果会发送到 Brave 云端
reasons.en: Queries and results are sent to Brave’s cloud

reasons.zh: API key 有配额与计费
reasons.en: The API key has quota and billing implications

note.zh: 需要 BRAVE_API_KEY（免费额度有限）；也支持 BRAVE_API_KEY_FILE 从文件读 key。
note.en: Needs BRAVE_API_KEY (limited free tier); BRAVE_API_KEY_FILE is also supported.

tagline.zh: 语义搜索、网页取正文与深度研究
tagline.en: Semantic search, page fetch and deep research

description.zh: Exa 官方 MCP server（exa-mcp-server 3.4.3，3 个工具）。web_search_exa 做语义搜索，web_fetch_exa 取网页正文，agent_run 跑多步研究；使用 EXA_API_KEY。
description.en: Official Exa MCP server (exa-mcp-server 3.4.3, 3 tools): web_search_exa for semantic search, web_fetch_exa for page contents, agent_run for multi-step research; uses EXA_API_KEY.

reasons.zh: 查询与网页内容会发送到 Exa 云端
reasons.en: Queries and page contents are sent to Exa’s cloud

reasons.zh: agent_run 会消耗较多额度
reasons.en: agent_run consumes more credits

note.zh: 需要 EXA_API_KEY；也可用远程 https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp（OAuth/远端托管）。
note.en: Needs EXA_API_KEY; the hosted endpoint https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp is also available (OAuth).

tagline.zh: 网页抓取、站内爬取与结构化提取
tagline.en: Scrape, crawl and extract structured web data

description.zh: Firecrawl 官方 MCP server（firecrawl-mcp 3.38.0，30 个工具）。支持 scrape/map/crawl/search、批量抓取、监控、论文检索与结构化提取；使用 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY。
description.en: Official Firecrawl MCP server (firecrawl-mcp 3.38.0, 30 tools): scrape/map/crawl/search, batch jobs, monitors, paper research and structured extraction; uses FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

reasons.zh: 可抓取任意公开网页，可能触及敏感/受限内容
reasons.en: Can scrape arbitrary public pages, including sensitive or restricted content

reasons.zh: 抓取与 agent 任务会消耗额度
reasons.en: Scraping and agent jobs consume credits

note.zh: 需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY；默认 stdio，抓取量大时注意额度。
note.en: Needs FIRECRAWL_API_KEY; stdio by default. Watch credits when crawling at scale.

tagline.zh: 无需 key 的网页搜索
tagline.en: Web search without an API key

description.zh: DuckDuckGo MCP server（duckduckgo-mcp-server 0.1.2，1 个工具）。duckduckgo_web_search 提供无需 key 的网页搜索，适合轻量查询；DDG 有频率限制。
description.en: DuckDuckGo MCP server (duckduckgo-mcp-server 0.1.2, 1 tool). duckduckgo_web_search gives key-free web search for light queries; DDG rate-limits aggressively.

reasons.zh: 查询会发送到 DuckDuckGo
reasons.en: Queries are sent to DuckDuckGo

reasons.zh: 无 key，但可能被频率限制
reasons.en: No key, but requests may be rate-limited

note.zh: 无需 key；DDG 可能返回“请求过快”的异常，属上游限流，不代表 server 坏了。
note.en: No key; DDG may return a rate-limit anomaly, which comes from upstream and does not mean the server is broken.

tagline.zh: 调用 Apify Store 的抓取 Actor
tagline.en: Run scraping Actors from Apify Store

description.zh: Apify 官方 MCP server（@apify/actors-mcp-server 0.21.4，13 个工具）。搜索 Apify Store、运行 Actor、读取数据集与 KV，覆盖数千个现成抓取器；需要 APIFY_TOKEN。
description.en: Official Apify MCP server (@apify/actors-mcp-server 0.21.4, 13 tools). Search Apify Store, run Actors and read datasets/key-value stores across thousands of scrapers; requires APIFY_TOKEN.

reasons.zh: 会运行第三方 Actor，抓取外部网页
reasons.en: Runs third-party Actors that scrape external sites

reasons.zh: Actor 运行会产生 Apify 费用
reasons.en: Actor runs consume Apify credits

note.zh: 需要 APIFY_TOKEN；可设置 APIFY_DEFAULT_ACTOR 等参数，运行前注意 Actor 计费。
note.en: Needs APIFY_TOKEN; APIFY_DEFAULT_ACTOR and similar settings are available. Check Actor pricing before running.
